Question: I am working with bank's collection agency as a computer operater. I get to know from islamic research foundation(mumbai)it is not permitted to deal any kind of riba (intreast)based dealing. My work is only that if payment collected by feald executive i wright down it and send it to bank this payment is collected.Now i am resinged my job.Mene jo pesa yaha se kamaya hai usse 1 motorcycle li hai it is correct to use motorcycle? Answer ID: 5421 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2035/780=H/1429) Yes, it can ne utilised. But, if you know that such and such amount is of interest then you should give that much amount in charity to the poor without any intention of getting reward. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
